messages:
lucy (Support): Customer reports token cost card shows $0 or NaN for some orgs. They attached a screenshot and say it started after the nightly rollup.
omar (Billing): Which orgs and subaccounts?
lucy (Support): Org ids: 99887, 99888. They see usage numbers in /api/usage but totals on the dashboard read $0; tooltip shows NaN. Customer is on a reserved plan.
metricbot: Incident INCIDENT-20250612-09 created by lucy (Support)
kai (SRE): I'll start with rollup logs and trace price-lookup. @omar did pricing see anything around 2025-06-12 00:00 UTC?
omar (Billing): We logged transient 502/503s from price-lookup in us-east-1 between 00:01-00:05 UTC. Some lookups returned empty result sets.
tia (Console): Frontend note: different codepaths coerce price differently. `Number(null)` -> 0, `parseFloat(null)` -> NaN, and some React renderers treat undefined as empty string. That would explain inconsistent $0 vs NaN between card and hover.
kai (SRE): Aggregator wrote daily rollup rows with unit_price = NULL when price lookup returned nothing. Downstream UI math then diverged.
lucy (Support): Customer wants ETA and whether historical numbers will be correct after fixes.
kai (SRE): Short-term mitigation: trigger targeted backfills for the affected orgs for the date 2025-06-12. I've queued backfill job backfill-20250612-2 for both orgs.
commands-bot: /enqueue-backfill --org 99887 --date 2025-06-12
commands-bot: /enqueue-backfill --org 99888 --date 2025-06-12
omar (Billing): I'll run a reconciliation to seed missing price rows from last-known valid price. Note: special subaccount 7 on 99888 uses contract-specific pricing; might need manual check.
tia (Console): I'll push a small hotfix to normalize null/NaN in the UI and display "estimated" next to any value derived from fallback pricing. Patch is on staging now.
metricbot: backfill-20250612-2: success for org 99887; partial success for org 99888 (missing price for subaccount 7).
kai (SRE): Verified DB aggregates updated for 99887. 99888 has remaining rows to reconcile; coordinating with billing/contracts.
omar (Billing): Reconciliation filled most missing price rows. For the special subaccount we need contract confirmation — pinged @contracts.
lucy (Support): Notified customer: backfill applied for one org, partial for the other; UI hotfix deployed; full reconciliation in progress. They asked for a postmortem and timeframe.
omar (Billing): Permanent fixes planned: (1) aggregator should default to last-known price instead of NULL; (2) alert on price-lookup 5xx rate > 1% over 5m; (3) backfill audit and one-off reconciliation for the last 7 days. I'll own the billing changes.
tia (Console): I'll add unit/integration tests for null/NaN rendering and schedule the full UI rollout within 72 hours.
kai (SRE): Drafting incident report with timeline, affected orgs, logs and runbook steps. Will attach link when ready.
lucy (Support): Thanks all — I'll update the customer and close the ticket once they confirm dashboard looks correct. :thumbsup:
